knowledge_sources.title: China BYD Qin Plus commute notes
knowledge_sources.summary: Qin Plus is commonly treated as a value-forward commuter sedan with electrified appeal.
knowledge_sources.text: BYD Qin Plus is often recommended to China-market buyers who care most about commute efficiency, low running costs, and a modern electrified sedan format. Used examples still need checks on charging behavior, software updates, and overall cosmetic condition.

knowledge_sources.title: China BYD Song Plus family SUV notes
knowledge_sources.summary: Song Plus remains a high-volume China-market family SUV because it combines cabin space, electrified options, and strong value positioning.
knowledge_sources.text: BYD Song Plus is often shortlisted by China-market buyers who want a family SUV with strong value, modern cabin tech, and a choice of EV or plug-in-hybrid powertrains. Used buyers should still verify battery condition, charging accessories, and service history instead of assuming every high-volume model is automatically low-risk.

knowledge_sources.title: China Honda CR-V family notes
knowledge_sources.summary: CR-V remains a mainstream family crossover choice for buyers who want cabin space and an easy-to-accept badge.
knowledge_sources.text: Honda CR-V is still frequently recommended in China when the buyer wants a mainstream family SUV with practical space and easy daily driving. It usually works best when comfort and cabin flexibility matter more than sportiness.

knowledge_sources.title: China Tesla Model Y crossover notes
knowledge_sources.summary: Model Y stays popular in China because it offers an electric family-crossover shape with strong charging familiarity and broad recognition.
knowledge_sources.text: Tesla Model Y remains a common benchmark in China-market EV shopping because it combines crossover practicality, strong acceleration, and familiar fast-charging support. Used examples still need careful inspection for tyres, panel fit, and charging behavior.

knowledge_sources.title: China Toyota Camry comfort notes
knowledge_sources.summary: Camry remains a comfort-focused sedan reference point for family and business use in China.
knowledge_sources.text: Toyota Camry is still one of the safest midsize-sedan recommendations in the China market when the buyer wants comfort, hybrid efficiency, and mainstream resale confidence. Buyers should still verify condition and usage history, especially on cars that may have done heavy commuter or business mileage.

knowledge_sources.title: US Honda CR-V space and comfort notes
knowledge_sources.summary: CR-V is commonly praised for rear-seat comfort and practical cargo flexibility.
knowledge_sources.text: In the US market, Honda CR-V is often treated as a safe default for family buyers who want good rear-seat room, easy ingress, and flexible cargo space. It usually fits small-family commuting and road-trip use better than smaller crossovers.

knowledge_sources.title: US Honda Civic first-car notes
knowledge_sources.summary: Civic is a reliable compact recommendation for buyers who want efficiency and low drama.
knowledge_sources.text: Honda Civic works well for buyers who want a compact car that feels easy to drive, simple to park, and predictable to own. It is especially strong when the search is about commuting, first-car confidence, and not overpaying for a larger vehicle than necessary.

knowledge_sources.title: US Tesla Model Y EV family notes
knowledge_sources.summary: Model Y is popular with US buyers who want an electric family crossover with space and charging-network convenience.
knowledge_sources.text: Tesla Model Y appeals to buyers who want an electric crossover with useful family space, fast acceleration, and mature charging support. Buyers should still check tyre condition, panel quality, and charging habits rather than assuming every used example is low-risk.

knowledge_sources.title: US Toyota Camry commute notes
knowledge_sources.summary: Camry stays popular as a commuter and family sedan because it balances comfort, efficiency, and easy ownership.
knowledge_sources.text: Toyota Camry is one of the safest recommendations for buyers who want a midsize sedan for commuting and family duty. Hybrid trims usually deliver the easiest running-cost story, while non-hybrid versions remain straightforward mainstream options.

knowledge_sources.title: US Toyota RAV4 family SUV notes
knowledge_sources.summary: RAV4 remains a mainstream family SUV with broad practicality and strong resale confidence in the US market.
knowledge_sources.text: Toyota RAV4 is widely chosen by US buyers who need a family SUV with useful cargo room, predictable running costs, and easy resale. Hybrid trims usually appeal to commuters and families who want lower fuel spend without giving up SUV practicality.
